gallery.title: Specimen Island
gallery.description: First-person field biology on a forgotten dinosaur preserve: creep through jungle and tall grass, dart and sample raptors, trikes and a tyrant without killing them — or go loud and pay for it in points. Photograph the wildlife, ride the trail bike, take the sea lab's submarine down to the reefs, or raid the abandoned army camp for a tank and a heat-seeking gunship. Three.js.
